&reftitle.description;
boolstream_wrapper_unregister stringprotocol
Allows you to disable an already defined stream wrapper. Once the wrapper has been disabled you may override it with a user-defined wrapper using stream_wrapper_register or, if it is a built-in wrapper, re-enable it later on with stream_wrapper_restore. A user-defined wrapper cannot be restored: once unregistered, it is gone.
Unregistering a built-in wrapper affects the current request only, and breaks everything that relies on it. After stream_wrapper_unregister('file'), fopen, file_get_contents, opendir, include and SplFileObject fail on plain paths, and file_exists returns &false;, while glob and realpath keep working. A stream that was already open keeps working.
